newsitem.title: INDIA: India HDFC cuts interest on housing loan.
newsitem.headline: India HDFC cuts interest on housing loan.

text.p: India's Housing Development Finance Corporation Ltd (HDFC) on Monday said it was cutting interest rates on housing loans with immediate effect.
"Responding to market conditions, HDFC has once again taken the lead and has announced a further reduction in interest rates for individual housing loans," it said in a statement.
"This reduction is within three months of the previous reduction in interest rates effected in February 1997," it said.

The revised rates (with earlier rates in brackets) are as follows: loans from 25,001 to 200,000 rupees 15.5 percent (16.0 percent), 200,001 to 500,000 rupees 16.0 percent (16.5 percent), 500,001 to one million rupees 16.5 percent (17.0 percent) and 1000,001 to 25 million 17 percent (18.0 percent).

"Considering that a majority of loan seekers all over India fall into the 100,000 rupees to 200,000 rupees bracket, the interest rate on this most significant slab has now become most attractive at 15.5 percent per annum," HDFC said.
HDFC's action is in line with a general fall in interest rates in the Indian economy, analysts said.
